text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new year is here, and Aston Machan
and I are
going for our first shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Testing, testing.
Hi! It's Machan. Today,
I'm visiting a shrine with
my trainer for
the first time this year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are so many people today. One of
them
might just notice I'm here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of stalls set up as well. I
think I'll
eat something while we're here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's all from me for this New Year's
recording.
See you soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've noticed that Aston Machan has
taken to
making voice recordings for
fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our blog has gained quite a bit more
traffic this
last year thanks to her success
in the Sprinters
Stakes.
choice_data_list_en: (...This could be good material for a 4-panel comic.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully this trend continues into the
new year
as well, even if the growth
rate's only gentle.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So... What do you think? What looks
tasty?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh. These smell great.
Excuse me, could
I have one taiyaki, please?

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here you are. ...Oh? Are you
perhaps Aston
Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yes, that's right. I'm Aston
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor A
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! I saw you in the Sprinters
Stakes on
TV! You ran like the wind
blows!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I'm going to work even harder
this year,
so please keep cheering for—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance to where the shrieking is coming
from...
and see a crowd of people
forming around some
familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I went to see you run in the Shuka Sho
and the
Arima Kinen! The tension
between you two was so
intense I could
literally feel it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet Fan A
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see you both compete again this year!

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, um, is it true you're always fighting
at the
academy?! But you're doing your
first shrine visit
of the year together,
so?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
P-please calm down a little, everyone! If
you
make too much noise, you'll bother
the other
visitors!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And actually, today is our day off, so
please look
to the latest magazines if
you'd like updates—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, c'mon! We can give these guys
a little
attention! Look how much
passion they have!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! We're gonna answer one
question! And
then we're done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A surge of excitement passes through
the crowd
following Vodka's
announcement, and several
hands shoot
up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Okay, you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet Fan B
text_block_list.text: Is there one title in particular each of you really want to take for yourself during senior year?!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...
A title I want to take for myself...

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...The autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a commotion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan lets out a small sigh at
the distant
circle of New Year's
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It seems pretty tough to have all eyes on
you.

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor A
text_block_list.text:
...Those two really were a sight to
behold last
year. Whatever the weather,
clashes between
rivals are just plain
fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor A
text_block_list.text:
But you held your own too. You did
great in the
Sprinters Stakes, and in your
classic year in
general.

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor A
text_block_list.text:
You've got nothing to be glum about,
you know.
You have fans of your own,
remember.

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor A
text_block_list.text: ...Here! Have another taiyaki, on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A perplexed Aston Machan takes the
bag of two
taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor A
text_block_list.text: Good luck! I'll be rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you very much. I'll do my
best.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I'll eat one now, and I can save
the
other for tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...No, never mind. I've got it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Here. Let's eat them together, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gladly accept the taiyaki, feeling the
distance
between us shrink just a little.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch. ...It's really nice.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I felt a bit deflated, but the taiyaki is a
small
comfort.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I just have to be myself. I have to be
Machan. So,
first, I'm going to cherish
my friends and—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I haven't wished my friends a Happy New
Year
yet!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There's Chloe Harvard, whose very aura
is
uplifting, the astute stray cat Hattori

Shinobimaru, and then Antley, of course,
who has
infinite potential lying dormant
within!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Okay... The first friend we should go see
iiis...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Right. It has to be Chloe first!
choice_data_list: 元気をくれるクロエ・ハーバードさんへ
天才ノラ猫の服部忍び丸へ
無限の可能性を秘めているアリ村さんへ
choice_data_list_en: To Chloe Harvard, who brings me so much cheer.
To Hattori Shinobimaru, the genius stray cat.
To Arimura-san, who harbors boundless potential.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year to you. Let's make it
another
one to remember.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How's your family? Have you done your
shrine
visit yet?

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw! Caw!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I see. Well, I'm glad you're well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Aston Machan goes around greeting
all of her
friends, the sun begins to set...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It'll get dark if we don't start heading
back soon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Right, then... Shall we head home?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us walk home along the
crimson-lit
road and into a new year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. Let's head for the
shopping arcade.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hattori Shinobimaruuu. Meowww...
I
don't see him anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...What's that?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe! There he is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
He's taking a nap. I barely recognized
him since
he looks like a little ball of
mochi all curled up
like that.
Are you
relaxing because it's New Year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Aston Machan goes around greeting
all of her
friends, the sun begins to set...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It'll get dark if we don't start heading
back soon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Right, then... Shall we head home?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us walk home along the
crimson-lit
road and into a new year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, good. It's unlikely we'll run into
him... but
that's exactly why we should
try and find him
before the others!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. He's usually around here
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, little ants. Okay, Grant, Dante,
Antrew... I
have a question for you all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you happen to know where Antley
is?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Aston Machan goes around greeting
all of her
friends, the sun begins to set...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It'll get dark if we don't start heading
back soon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Right, then... Shall we head home?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us walk home along the
crimson-lit
road and into a new year.
